gate_reasons: all questions answered by the operator; blast-radius auth surface explicitly approved
synthesis: OTP sign-in cannot work on deployed non-production environments because testers have no reachable inbox there, which blocks QA from signing in at all. Let CustomLoginPage go straight from a valid, eligible platform-user email to an authenticated session when the app is not production, leaving the production email->OTP->verify flow untouched behind a hard guard.

scope.summary: Add a non-production bypass branch to CustomLoginPage::authenticate() that logs in an eligible user by email without sending/verifying an OTP, gated on a hard non-production check. Reuse sendOtp()'s existing user-existence + canAccessPanel eligibility check verbatim. Add tests for the non-prod bypass and the prod-still-required paths. Guard is environment-only (! app()->isProduction()); no new config flag. UI goes straight through with no OTP field. Existing rateLimit(5) retained. Bypassed logins are marked in the activity log.

proposed_changes.change: Insert a non-production bypass branch in authenticate() before the !otp_sent -> sendOtp() branch; resolve the user with the same lookup+canAccessPanel eligibility check, log in via Filament::auth()->login($user), fall through to the existing shared post-login tail.
proposed_changes.reason: Sole OTP gate in the app; the bypass must intercept before any OTP is sent.

proposed_changes.change: Extract the 'find eligible user by email' logic into one private helper used by BOTH sendOtp() and the new bypass.
proposed_changes.reason: One source of truth for the security-relevant eligibility check; two copies would drift.

proposed_changes.change: Add three tests: non-prod known email logs in with no OTP; non-prod unknown email still fails; production still requires OTP end-to-end.
proposed_changes.reason: AC4 requires automated coverage of both directions.

out_of_scope: app/Filament/Auth/OneTimePassword.php, the OTP cache format/TTL, and the notification/mail templates - the production path is unchanged.
The existing routes/web.php __qa/login/{id} dev-login route - a separate shipped mechanism, not rewired by this ticket.
Per-panel differentiation (app vs client) - both share the one CustomLoginPage, confirmed by backstop.
A new opt-in config flag and the matching deploy-workflow wiring - explicitly declined (Q1): a flag would ship the bypass OFF on preprod/PR previews.
Extra throttling / host / IP restriction beyond the existing rateLimit(5) - explicitly declined (Q3).

acceptance_criteria.item: Entering a known user email on a non-prod environment completes login without requiring OTP.
Entering an unknown / non-existent email still fails (no login).
acceptance_criteria.reason: Bypass reuses sendOtp()'s eligibility check, so ineligible emails hit the same Account Not Found path.

acceptance_criteria.item: Production behavior is unchanged (OTP still required).
acceptance_criteria.reason: Bypass unreachable when the hard non-production guard fails.

acceptance_criteria.item: Covered by automated tests for non-prod bypass and prod-still-required paths.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Three new tests in the existing CustomLoginPageTest.

questions.answer: No. Real APP_ENV values in use are local, testing, and preprod - and preprod covers BOTH the shared qa deploy (kamal-deploy.yml:49) and every PR preview (kamal-pr-preview.yml:98), which is exactly the environment the ticket is about. A negative check (!app()->isProduction()) covers all three and any future non-prod name.

questions.q: Should the bypass require the same eligibility as sendOtp() (exists AND canAccessPanel), or bare email existence?
questions.answer: Reuse the identical canAccessPanel check at CustomLoginPage.php:127-134. The ticket says do not skip the user lookup, and existing tests already pin that a merely-existing but ineligible user must fail.

questions.q: Does this apply to both the app and client panels?
questions.answer: Yes by construction - both panels wire ->login(CustomLoginPage::class) through PlatformPanelProvider:32, and the backstop confirmed no second 'extends Login' class exists.

questions.q: Should an opt-in config flag gate the bypass IN ADDITION to the environment check?

DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED is forced to "false" on preprod (kamal-deploy.yml:55) and PR previews (kamal-pr-preview.yml:104) - the exact environments this ticket targets. If the new bypass is gated behind a similar opt-in flag it ships OFF there and AC1 silently fails. Environment-only guard, or environment+flag with a coordinated workflow change?
questions.answer: Environment-only. No new flag, no deploy-workflow change; the bypass must work on preprod and PR previews out of the box.

questions.q: What should the UI do - does submitting the email go straight to an authenticated redirect with the OTP field never appearing, or does the OTP step still render and auto-succeed?
questions.answer: Straight through - submit email, authenticated redirect, the OTP field never renders.

questions.q: Is the existing rateLimit(5) enough, given this removes the 'possession of the inbox' factor on VPC-reachable preprod hosts (unlike __qa/login, which is loopback-only)?
questions.answer: Yes - rateLimit(5) is sufficient. No extra throttle, no host/IP restriction. preprod holds non-production data behind the VPC.

questions.q: Should the auth activity log mark the bypass explicitly instead of logging otp => 'N/A'?
questions.answer: Yes - log the bypass explicitly (e.g. otp => 'BYPASSED_NON_PROD').

notes: activity() log at CustomLoginPage.php:108-114 records 'otp' => $otp_data['otp'] ?? 'N/A'; in the bypass branch it will log 'N/A'. Consider an explicit BYPASSED_NON_PROD marker for the auth audit trail.
routes/web.php:161-196 documents its 4-layer non-prod guard with reasoning about all layers failing simultaneously. Mirror that commenting rigor.

tests.what_it_pins: non-prod known email authenticates in one submit, no OTP field, no notification sent
non-prod unknown email still fails with Account Not Found, stays guest
APP_ENV=production still requires the full send-then-verify OTP flow

grounding.code_flow: submit -> authenticate() -> rateLimit(5) -> if !otp_sent: sendOtp() (User by email + canAccessPanel, send OTP, set otp_sent) -> else: re-find user, compare cached OTP, Filament::auth()->login() -> shared tail (canAccessAnyPanel, session regenerate, activity log, LoginResponse). Bypass intercepts between rateLimit and the otp_sent branch.

sites.reason: sole OTP gate, no environment check today - where the bypass belongs
separate shipped dev-login route; template for guard rigor, not modified
production path only; bypass never calls it
single wiring point for both panels - no second surface to patch

resource_envelope.trigger: Login-path conditional, once per interactive sign-in. No command, job, query class, migration, or data-driven iteration.

plan_sketch.intent: non-prod known email logs in with no OTP field and no notification
non-prod unknown email fails, stays guest
APP_ENV=production still sends and requires the OTP
the three tests live in CustomLoginPageTest and pass in CI

qa_hint.seed_scenario: No new seed data - existing createUser()/createClientPortalUser() helpers cover both canAccessPanel branches.

blast_radius_approval.basis: Operator chose the environment-only guard (Q1) and accepted the rateLimit(5) exposure posture (Q3) with the VPC/preprod tradeoff stated explicitly.
